messages:
Mia: quick design sync — playing with the streamed chat UI: token counter keeps jumping around when new chunks arrive. Thoughts on pinning it to top-right of the message bubble?
Jun: agreed, jumping is noisy. pinning seems fine. worried about overlap with prompt suggestions — maybe it should collapse when suggestions are visible.
Ara: could avoid overlap by collapsing into a small pill that only shows on hover/focus. quick sketch:
Ara: ```css
.token-pill { position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 12px; transition: width 120ms; }
.suggestions-open .token-pill { width: 28px; }
``` 
Liam: small pill sounds good but accessibility: make sure it's keyboard-focusable and has aria-label="token count"; color contrast needs checking.
Mia: +1 on aria. also UX semantics: Stop vs Pause vs Regenerate — how do we signal state? my instinct: Stop = abort and leave partial response + show Retry/Regenerate; Pause = temporarily stop the stream and show Resume.
Jun: remember we want minimal controls for new users. maybe default to Stop/Regenerate only, and hide Pause in advanced settings.
Ara: microcopy idea: show token deltas during stream like "+45 tokens" briefly on the pill, then collapse to total on finish.
Liam: accessibility nit — current gray on light for the pill fails AA at small sizes. Suggest using #0B66FF for icon or invert background with white text.
designbot: recorded a quick demo and added notes in the Figma file: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/Playground-Stream-UX
Mia: thanks! @Jun can you mock the compact pill + collapse behavior and the stop/regenerate copy change in the prototype? would also like to see the prompt library insertion flow recalibrate tokens and highlight insertion briefly. :eyes:
Jun: yup — will post a prototype by EOD and call out a11y checklist. :rocket:
